Most seeds want warm soil, steady water and patience. Sow them twice as deep as they are wide, firm the soil, and keep it damp until the first leaves show.
Beans: sow after the last frost.
Kale: sow in early spring or late summer.
Squash: sow on a mound, three seeds together.
